# GENERATED by scripts/check_doc_coverage.sh --write — the exact set of
# public vars in the bundled namespaces that carry NO docstring.
#
# This is a LEDGER OF DECISIONS, not a target. A name here means: this var
# is reachable by a user, `(doc …)` on it prints nothing, and that is
# currently accepted. Removing a name (by writing the docstring) is the
# improvement; a name APPEARING here without intent is the bug the gate
# catches.
#
# Known clusters, so the list is read rather than skimmed:
#   clojure.pprint — the ~50 cljw-internal `cl-*` formatter helpers were
#     made private 2026-08-04 (upstream keeps them private too), which is
#     why this cluster is now small: they were a leaked API surface, not a
#     documentation gap, and `defn-` was the fix rather than prose.
#   clojure.math   — DONE 2026-08-04 with AUTHORED prose, not imported:
#     upstream's docstrings all end in a java.lang.Math Javadoc URL, which
#     would be a Java-8 link as the reference for a runtime that has no
#     java.lang.Math. Every behavioural claim in the authored text is a
#     golden pair in test/diff/clj_corpus/math_doc_claims.txt.
#   clojure.core   — the residue after core_meta.clj; mostly `-`-prefixed
#     protocol methods and earmuffed dynamics upstream does not document
#     either.
#
# Regenerate with: bash scripts/check_doc_coverage.sh --write
